notes: Signed injected-defect board (task 011d sec.4; proposal signed by Yue Xiangyu on 2026-09-19). Derived from reviewsets/injected/fixed-base.epro2 (the corrected reference board) by reviewsets/injected/make_variants.py, which is the only writer of this file. Fault: U3's value field changed to 4.7k while its MPN decodes 1k (4.70x apart, past the R tolerance). Edit: rewrite U3's Value attribute only. The defect record below is the whole ground truth for the INJECTED fault: the named rule must catch it, and anything that rule adds beyond this record is a false positive. Findings from other rules are the base board's own (this board is the base plus one edit, and the base's records live in fixed-base.json) -- they land in the harness's unexplained column here, which is why the per-variant report quotes the expected rule's own columns rather than the board total. Split: dev (011e sec.2 -- assigned by sha1(id), see make_variants.py). Oracle note: the single-field contradiction, now first-of-its-kind: the base has U3's value and MPN agreeing at 1k (the oracle's ruling), so this edit is the only disagreement on the board. **Re-signed 2026-09-21** (task 015 batch 2): the injected value was 2.2k, and under batch 2's amplitude ruling 2.2k/1k = 2.20x sits below the 3x R tolerance -- the rule would report OK and the injection would not be caught at all. Measured side effect of the move to 4.7k, not hidden: 4.7k also leaves ``param-led-current``'s [470, 2200] ohm window, so this board now carries a second finding (a WARN on LED1, a ref its records do not claim). The conflict is structural -- the window's ceiling is 2200 ohm = 2.20x of this board's own 1k MPN -- so no value-field edit can be both >= 3x and inside the window. FINAL RULING 2026-09-21 (task 015 batch 2; oracle decision A, category tolerances R 3x / C 25x). The ruling's own words for the complaint are quoted in the rule (``MPN_AMPLITUDE_TOLERANCE_R``, src/boardwise/rules/params.py): the injected value moved 2.2k -> 4.7k ohm so that the disagreement reads 4.70x and stays a violation at or above the 3x tolerance.
